run_glue_tasks: run GLUE transfer tasks like MNLI-m, QQP, SST-2, and CoLA using a pretrained XLM model
run_xnli_task: run XNLI cross-lingual natural language inference evaluation with a pretrained XLM model
build_sentence_embedder: build a SentenceEmbedder from a pretrained XLM model path for downstream transfer learning
configure_finetuning: configure finetuning layers, dropout, and optimizer settings for GLUE or XNLI transfer tasks
run_transfer_evaluation: run transfer evaluation on specified GLUE and XNLI tasks with a pretrained model and data path
